messages:
morgan: Hey, quick first-week onboarding question — I'm remote (GMT+2). My YubiKey shipment got delayed, laptop is enrolled in MDM but FileVault recovery key dialog never showed up. Do I need to provision the recovery key somewhere or will IT push it? @it-ops

it-ops: Hey Morgan — welcome! Can you confirm macOS version and whether FileVault shows 'Turn On' or 'Turn Off' in System Settings > Privacy & Security? If it's already on we can retrieve the escrowed key but we don't auto-push keys.

morgan: macOS 13.5, it shows 'FileVault is turned on' but SecureToken shows pending in our onboarding doc? I also can't add a YubiKey as a second factor; Okta errors with code 409. I opened ticket INC-5421.

raj: @morgan for YubiKeys ping me — I'll check with hardware ops and shipping. For Okta 409 typically the user record isn't in the right group yet. @ana can you confirm SSO groups?

ana: (typo in my name corrected) — Sorry, meant to say @ana.

ana: Confirmed, you were missing the 'engineers' group mapping in Okta; added you and triggered a sync. Wait ~60s and try enrolling the token again. Also run `profiles status` and paste the output if problems persist.

morgan: Re-ran `profiles status` — it shows MDM enrolled, Device Identity: ok, FileVault escrow: none. How do I get the recovery key into escrow so it shows up in the console?

it-ops: We can remote-generate and escrow a personal recovery key for you, but need your consent + a quick screen share to run commands. If you'd rather do it yourself the supported command is:

```sudo fdesetup changerecovery -personal -escrow```

Run that while on the call and we'll confirm the key appears in the MDM console. We won't ask for the key itself in chat.

morgan: I'll schedule a 15-min screen share. Also about PhishSim training — the portal shows 'assigned' but my scheduled simulation is next month; can that be moved up? I'm in customer-facing meetings early.

security-bot: PhishSim: Morgan's assignment updated to 'due in 7 days' by People Ops. Reminder will send 48h prior. :mailbox_with_mail:

raj: We normally only accelerate for high-risk cohorts, but I bumped your priority manually since you're customer-facing. Complete the training modules and we'll target the simulated campaign for next Tuesday.

morgan: Thanks — that helps. One last item: company VPN client prompts for a machine cert but I don't have admin to install the cert. Is there an automated installer or a one-time service install?

it-ops: We have a signed installer: https://internal.redwood/it/vpn-installer — it requires admin to run. If you don't have admin access, we can remote-install during the screen share. Bring credentials for Okta SSO so we can validate.

alex_p: Also, if you need to temporarily use a personal device, file a 'contractor exception' in the security portal. Policy requires full disk encryption, AV, and the device on a gated network. Happy to help you fill the form if needed.

morgan: Scheduling the screen share now for 10:30 AM CET. Appreciate the quick support, everyone! :raised_hands:
